metaDescription: Most shapewear is built for a two hour night out. These five were built for a twelve hour day. Here is what holds up.

cover.title: 5 Shapewear Pieces Women Are Actually Wearing Every Day (Not Just for Events)
cover.subtitle: Most shapewear is built for a two hour night out. These five were built for a twelve hour day. Here is what holds up.

cami.heading: The cami that smooths your middle and does not roll up
cami.sku: Shapermint Essentials All Day Every Day Scoop Neck Cami
cami.body: This is the piece most women start with, and the reason is simple. It gives you 360 degree tummy control and bust support in one lightweight layer, so you smooth your middle without the squeezed, breath holding feeling that makes you want to change at 3pm. It does not roll up when you sit, walk or reach. You can wear it with a bra or skip the bra entirely.
cami.bestFor: Under blouses, tees and fitted tops, worn all day
cami.problem: Camis that roll up, and shapewear that feels like it is squeezing everywhere
cami.imageAlt: Shapermint Essentials All Day Every Day Scoop Neck Cami

leggings.heading: The leggings that quietly double as shapewear
leggings.body: Most women think they have to pick one, comfort or shape. These are leggings you would wear on a normal day, with an anti roll silicone strip at the waist that keeps them where you put them and 360 degree smoothing from waist to ankle. The fabric is opaque and non see through, which is the part cheap leggings get wrong. Wear them as pants, or as the smoothing layer under a dress.
leggings.bestFor: Daily wear as pants, travel, or as a smoothing layer under dresses
leggings.problem: Having to choose between comfortable and shaping, and leggings that show everything

sweetheart.heading: The all in one that replaces three layers
sweetheart.sku: Shapermint Essentials Sweetheart Built-In Bra Shaper Cami
sweetheart.body: Stop layering. Stop adjusting. This one has a built in wireless bra with light foam cups, so there is no bra underneath, no strap chaos, no third layer to fight with in the morning. It sculpts 360 degrees from bust to tummy, and the sweetheart neckline is finished enough that it works as a top on its own rather than something you hide.
sweetheart.bestFor: Days you do not want to wear a bra, and as a standalone top
sweetheart.problem: Wearing a bra, a cami and a shaper at the same time
sweetheart.imageAlt: Shapermint Essentials Sweetheart Built-In Bra Shaper Cami

shorts.heading: The shorts that do not roll down or ride up
shorts.sku: Shapermint Essentials All Day Every Day High-Waisted Shaper Shorts
shorts.body: The waistband has an anti slip silicone strip, which is the whole reason these stay put. No roll down, no chub rub, no readjusting in the bathroom, even if you sit through a long meeting, stretch or dance. You get a smooth line from tummy to thigh, the fabric is non see through, and you can wear them with or without underwear.
shorts.bestFor: Dresses, skirts, work outfits and warm weather
shorts.problem: Waistbands that fold over by lunch, and thigh chafing
shorts.imageAlt: Shapermint Essentials All Day Every Day High-Waisted Shaper Shorts

empower.heading: The one for when you want more shape, not more squeeze
empower.sku: Shapermint Essentials Everyday Empower High-Waisted Shaper Short
empower.body: This is the step up for the days that ask for more. Targeted bonded panels on the belly and sides give you an instant snatch without the bulk or the stiffness, so it is firm where you want it and soft everywhere else. Laser cut edges are fully seamless, which means no visible line under a thin or tight dress. Women report wearing them 12 to 14 hours at weddings and forgetting they had them on.
empower.bestFor: Fitted dresses, weddings, photos and long days on your feet
empower.problem: Compression that squeezes everywhere instead of shaping, and visible edges under tight clothes
empower.imageAlt: Shapermint Essentials Everyday Empower High-Waisted Shaper Short
